title: Make your page look right on phones
blurb: Check the mobile layout and fix text, spacing and hidden bits for small screens.

steps.title: Open Funnels
steps.body: Click **Funnels**, or **Websites** for a website page.

steps.title: Open the page
steps.body: Open your funnel, pick the step and click **Edit**.

steps.title: Switch to mobile
steps.body: At the top of the builder, click the phone icon. The page shrinks to phone width so you can see what most visitors see.
steps.tip: Most local customers will open your page on a phone, so check this every time.

steps.title: Fix text size and spacing
steps.body: Click any element while in mobile view and adjust font size, padding and margins. Many of these changes apply to mobile only, so desktop stays as it was.

steps.title: Hide what does not fit
steps.body: Select a section or element, open **Styles** in the right panel and use **Visibility** to show it on desktop only or mobile only.

steps.title: Check on a real phone
steps.body: Click **Save**, then **Preview** and open the link on your own phone. Tap every button and fill in the form.
